title: Christmas de Stocking
summary:
Oil from the world's largest Petroleum Reserve is for sale
In recent years, global oil markets have focused on the growth of the Strategic Petroleum Reserves (SPR) in China and - more recently - India as important drivers for crude oil imports and tanker demand. Relatively little attention has been given to the world's largest inventory of emergency crude oil, the U.S. SPR, stored in huge underground salt caverns along the coastline of the Gulf of Mexico.
